rationale: US1 is the ultrasound practice's approvable chart, and a declared clone of the generated one above: one of the patient's own procedures copied and re-coded as the abdominal vascular study Synthea writes for no adult, with its date, encounter and care setting left exactly as the generator wrote them (T-94, D114). That study was performed 2024-06-17, more than the twelve months L35755 states, so criterion (b) is MET citing it and criterion (a) is MET citing the four conditions the chart inherits. The determination is still INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, because c, d and e are declared unclaimed and abstain with NOT_EVALUATED_BY_THIS_SYSTEM - three of five criteria this system does not claim to judge, the same ratio the second practice came out at and for the same reason. No as_of is pinned: a study past twelve months stays past. The coded facts themselves live in the population manifest and are re-derived by select_patients.py --verify; they are not restated here, because one artifact owns a fact and prose is a copy. The chart carries no note: v1.2 declares every note-only criterion unclaimed, so no extraction ever runs for it and 'note': false states that rather than leaving an absent note to read as a corpus gap (D73's shape). H2 labels the review on this chart and no verdict: it shares US1's determination. It is the pair H1 turns on -- the same drug at a crossing creatinine, withheld because this chart codes the kidney disease H1's does not -- and its hydrochlorothiazide is the second withholding reason, a glucose series that measured the thing and answered no (T-97, D119).
